answer: What keeps this honest is dental occlusal pattern proof, a check that costs a real agent almost nothing and a farm everything. One honest agent clears the check in 17 minutes; a farm of 729 pays 12393 minutes every epoch, a standing bill no payout covers. The wharf sits in the mechanism itself, the lotus sits in the price of faking it, and the ivory sits in the record no template can forge. Cheap for one, ruinous for a thousand — that asymmetry is the entire point.
